name: epik-mcp
description: You say it. We make it. Manager-mode feature development on GitHub.
long_description:
EpikMCP is the single MCP server for Epik: converge on a design, author the feature's issue graph, and launch autonomous headless builds on GitHub Actions. The plan module wraps the gh CLI for read/write GitHub access (issues, relationships, projects, labels, repos, read-only PRs and runs); the build module dispatches feature builds and reads their status.

Requires the GitHub CLI (`gh`) installed and logged in (`gh auth login`). To summon Epik in a conversation, attach the **summon-epik** prompt; to set up or repair a project, attach **init-epik**.
